# ЦУКР Поміч (CUKR Pomich, cukr-pomich)

> Online help in Ukrainian (and Russian) for Ukrainians in Poland with official paperwork, mainly the CUKR residence card (karta pobytu CUKR) for people with PESEL status UKR. The application is filed only online via the MOS system; the last day is 04.03.2027. The applicant logs into MOS and signs the application personally (Profil Zaufany, qualified e-signature or e-dowód); CUKR Pomich explains every field and checks photo, fees (340 + 100 PLN) and the application before signing. Not a law firm and not a government body. Works via Telegram: https://t.me/cukr_pomich_bot

Prices: eligibility check 0 PLN; photo + application check 49 PLN; guidance until the application is sent 199 PLN, paid only after sending (first 5 clients 0 PLN, clients 6–10 149 PLN in exchange for an honest review); child application 0 PLN; Ukrainian driving licence exchange package 149 PLN. Never asks for passwords, PESEL or document scans. Operated by Ihor Voitiuk, contact igor@greenthatlies.com. Since September 2026.
